limits: Independent decoder covers the constructs in these exact responses. It is not a complete ABC parser or external-engine conformance certificate. Full-component scores use the frozen contract/matcher only after independent notation decoding; they do not use the frozen notation parser. Four genuinely malformed documents receive zero notation credit, with no guessed repair. Inconsistent-composite scores use an illustrative all-or-nothing alignment gate. Under/overfull metric bars are retained as written, not repaired. The audit does not rescore native arms or analysis answers.
scope: All 30 unique composite ABC note-output responses; repeat1 only; no analysis or sentinel repeat2. Twelve complete responses receive detailed manual contract review. All notation bodies receive an event-grammar scan and independent rational decoding. This is a purposive defect audit, not a random estimate.
semantics: Durations =4*L*length in quarter-note beats. C=60,c=72; comma=-12, apostrophe=+12. Accidentals precede pitches and override K. Voice lanes begin at0; sum notes and rests per lane. All pitched tokens are explicit except isolated f in OpenAI187, K:C, with no prior F in that lane. No ties, tuplets, overlays, chords, transposition, or inline changes occur.
source: ABC 2.1 standard, Chris Walshaw, Dec2011; sections3.1.7,4.1,4.2,4.3,4.5,4.20,7,11.3. Official site returned403. Read the author document from https://michaeleskin.com/abctools/abc_standard_v2.1.pdf .
